name: Select obsolete component records
content:
Choose component records to delete for project {{project.id}} after the component writes for this run. This task is read only. Proposed names are {{task.define_components.output.component_names}}.

Use MCP knowledge_component_list and knowledge_component_get for this project only. Put an id in delete_ids when its name is not in the proposed names, or when it is not the current record for a proposed name. Keep the current record for each proposed name. If the proposed names are missing, fail and do not return a list. Do not delete anything yourself. The final stdout line is one JSON object with delete_ids, an array of id strings, sorted by numeric suffix. Do not use a markdown fence.
